category_a_business.overview: 북미 고객 및 소비자 기반 산업에 기술 중심 결제 및 대출 솔루션을 제공하는 금융 지주 회사입니다.
milestones: 2001: World Financial Network National Bank 인수
2019: Epsilon 매각 및 데이터 마케팅 사업 분리
2022: Bread Financial Holdings로 사명 변경 및 결제/대출 사업 집중
category_a_business.business_model: 소매업체와 제휴하여 신용카드 및 대출 상품을 제공하고 수수료 및 이자를 받습니다.
category_a_business.value_chain_position: Midstream + 소매업체와 소비자 사이에서 결제 및 대출 서비스를 중개합니다.
products: 할부 대출 및 분할 결제 상품 (Bread Pay)
category_a_business.key_customers: 소수의 주요 파트너에 대한 매출 의존도가 높으며, 파트너 이탈 시 매출에 큰 영향이 있을 수 있습니다.

competitive_advantages: Financial Services / Credit Services 카테고리 — yfinance peer 비교 권장

top_risks.description: Additional risks and uncertainties that we are unaware of, or that we currently believe are not material, may also become important factors that adversely affect our business.
If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future prospects could be materially and adversely affected.
Risks related to cybersecurity, technology and third-party vendors include: • We rely on third-party vendors, and could be adversely impacted if such vendors fail to fulfill their obligations.
Moreover, the current Presidential Administration’s policies on trade, immigration and taxes could create inflationary pressures, which in turn could disproportionately impact our customer base.
The loans we make are unsecured, and we may not be able to ultimately collect from customers that default on their loans.
As a result, the data and models upon which we rely may not fully reflect the extent of our customers’ actual financial obligations.

wikipedia_summary: Bread Financial Holdings, Inc. is an American publicly traded provider of private label credit cards, coalition loyalty programs, and direct marketing, derived from the capture and analysis of transaction-rich data.
